mentions.name: Punch TV: Fighting Game Show
mentions.description: A fighting game presented as a fighting game show, blending platform-brawler action with traditional versus fighting, described as a cross between Super Smash Bros and Street Fighter. Available on Google Play, the App Store, and Steam, made by the team whose previous game Maximus 2 won a Google indie award.
